acceptance: Each case: 15 processed bars, 10 filled orders, 5 closed positions, no open orders/positions, exact fill-ledger/cash/realized-PnL reconciliation. Stress fees total $10; model fill differences are observed rather than presumed.
scope: Retrospective scheduled diagnostic, not a strategy selection or profitability qualification. Orders use completed daily bar prices on predeclared dates, not a realizable closing-auction strategy. Daily OHLCV does not reconstruct intraday order books or publication times.
